title: BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Interview Letter 2026
vacancyDetails: Subject-wise vacancies vary by BSUSC advertisement. Check the relevant official advertisement/notice.
qualification: As prescribed in the relevant BSUSC Assistant Professor advertisement and applicable UGC rules.
ageLimit: As prescribed in the relevant BSUSC advertisement.
applicationFee: As prescribed in the relevant BSUSC advertisement.
selectionProcess: Shortlisting / Screening → Interview → Final Recommendation / Result
documentsRequired: Interview letter, valid photo ID, educational certificates, NET/SET/Ph.D. certificates where applicable, category certificate and other documents mentioned in the interview notice.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official BSUSC website.
2. Open the Ongoing Appointments / relevant Assistant Professor notice.
3. Find your subject and advertisement number.
4. Download the interview letter or related notice.
5. Check the interview date, venue and reporting instructions.
6. Attend the interview with the required original documents and copies.
shortDescription: BSUSC has published Assistant Professor interview-related notices for different subjects. Candidates should check the official BSUSC notice for their subject and advertisement number.
content:
Bihar State University Service Commission (BSUSC) has published interview-related notices for Assistant Professor posts in different subjects.

The official BSUSC website contains subject-wise notices, including interview schedules, rescheduling notices, shortlisting information and admit-card related notices. Candidates should check the notice applicable to their subject and advertisement number.
